summary: Smoke-tested all five requested APIs and the role-gated Expo web app at 390x844. APIs returned expected 200 responses and role screens loaded without horizontal overflow.

After tapping Publish dispatch, the expected Dispatch published confirmation was not observable in the web UI, despite POST /api/posts succeeding in API smoke testing.

Use EXPO_BACKEND_URL as the canonical frontend API environment variable per integration requirements; current code reads EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL and expo config backendUrl instead.

Live transport and payment collection are explicitly MOCKED, as documented; no real provider integration was tested.
Most Pressable controls lack accessibilityRole/accessibilityLabel despite the design accessibility requirements.
seed_data_creation: Created one TEST post, one ₹7 pending support intent, and one TEST live session through public API smoke checks; these remain persisted test records.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Role gate, client feed, reporter story/live screens, admin overview, and 390x844 overflow checks passed. Admin queue was empty, so detail modal resolve/keep-open controls were not exercised. Support/publish confirmation was not observable in Expo web.
rca_of_issue: The client and reporter handlers await fetch and then call React Native Alert.alert. The API smoke calls succeed, but the browser run could not find the expected Alert text after support/publish taps. This may be an Expo web Alert rendering/interaction issue or an unhandled rejected fetch path; add explicit UI status and log response/error state to make the flow verifiable.
